name: /work
description: Load context and identify next task

steps.description: Curate RIGHT NOW memory (0-7 days, OpenAI 2-pass)
Subconscious nudge — single-sentence pattern probe (DMN activation)

outputs.subconscious_nudge: One-sentence 💭 insight or empty if insufficient data

steps.command: command -v qmd >/dev/null 2>&1 && qmd search "$(basename $PWD)" -c enkratflow -n 3 --min-score 0.4 2>/dev/null || echo ''
steps.description: Surface cross-project context from QMD (skipped silently if not installed)

outputs.qmd_context: Top 3 related cross-project docs, empty if qmd not available

steps.action: Format and display the work brief
steps.context:
You are producing a work brief to re-orient the user into their project. Read git state and TODO.md natively before generating the brief.

Generate a rich, structured brief in this order:

1. RIGHT NOW - display right_now_section verbatim. IF right_now_section says 'No recent events found' or is empty or has fewer than 3 lines of real content: do NOT just show that message. Run 'ls -t .exocortex/events/*.md | head -3' and cat the 2 most recent event files directly. Reconstruct episodic context from those events. Label the section 'RIGHT NOW (last save: {date from filename} - no saves in last 7 days)' and summarise: what was last worked on, what decisions were made, what was flagged as next, any overdue items mentioned.

2. SHORT-TERM - display shortterm_memory verbatim.

3. SUBCONSCIOUS NUDGE - display subconscious_nudge prefixed with a thought bubble emoji if non-empty.

4. GIT STATE - run 'git status --short' and 'git branch --show-current' and 'git log --oneline -5'. Show: branch name, then list EVERY untracked and modified file by name. Do not just say 'N uncommitted files' - list them individually. Show the last 5 commits. Flag any branch name that looks pending a merge (feature/*, fix/*, phase/*).

5. OPEN ITEMS - read .exocortex/OPEN_DECISIONS.md if it exists and list unresolved decisions. Also scan the last 2 event files for overdue actions: pending API key rotations, pending branch merges, tasks held waiting for confirmation, known bugs not yet fixed.

6. NEXT TASK - show the first incomplete task group from the Ready section of .exocortex/TODO.md with all its sub-tasks.

7. RELATED CONTEXT - if qmd_context is non-empty, add a brief section with results.

Then show the A/B/C choice.

Quality bar: name actual files, branches, and decisions - not generic summaries. The brief must make the user feel immediately oriented and ready to work, not vaguely aware. If something was broken or blocked last session, say so explicitly.
